description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordStrengthValidation class, which evaluates the strength of user passwords using the ZxcvbnPhp library within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes constants for different strength levels and a method to assess password strength based on user credentials.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidation
classes.description: A utility class that assesses the strength of passwords using the Zxcvbn library and defines constants for various strength levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PasswordStrengthValidation class, creating an instance of the Zxcvbn password strength estimator.

methods.name: checkPasswordStrength
methods.description: Evaluates the strength of a user-provided password encapsulated within a UserCredential object, returning an integer score based on predefined levels.
